name: Seume2017_ORC_10kW_scale
source: Seume/Peters/Kunte, J. Phys. Conf. Ser. 821 (2017) 012023, Table 3
notes: Ethanol ORC impulse turbine scaled as air-proxy cascade (real-gas ethanol not modeled).
D_shroud=63.1 mm, h=3.43 mm, NR=33, n=100 krpm, ε_design=40%.

ImpulseCalc matches geometry scales, tip speed, impulse reaction — not η_t-s or ethanol maps.
